question: Why could the serpent-king not remain in his own world during the cloud season?
premises: The serpent-king had fainted into a sleep caused by poison born from the churning of the milk-ocean.
This condition affected him during the cloud season.
Because of this, he did not dwell in his own world.
inference: The serpent-king's affliction made his own realm uninhabitable for him in the rainy season.
uncertainties: The verse implies but does not explicitly state the causal link between the poison-sleep and leaving his world.
plain_english: The serpent-king, overcome by a sleep brought on by the poison born from the churning of the milk-ocean, did not remain in his own world during the cloud season.
